title: A link that opens the Quick Connect approval with the code filled in, for a QR code
notes: Issue #118. Waits for JS-037. D-083: the only form a QR sign-in takes. Promote when the project of a client that authorizes every media request states in an issue that it will draw the QR, when a supported TV app (docs/status.md) shows one, or when sign-ins by code are started and not finished often enough to matter. It becomes its own task after JS-039. First step then: observe whether jellyfin-web 12.4's approval page takes a code from its address (unverified). Terms: a signed-out device signs in by password or provider and returns to the approval; the page names the device and approves only on an explicit confirmation; one code, Quick Connect's expiry and bound. D-087: the link must open a page that survives a change of default client (D-083's /jellyscale/v1/ term). A line in an Octave issue stating the TV QR will be drawn promotes it, with no new decision. D-089: promoted to JS-179; the QR carries the address Jellyfin apps already draw, not a /jellyscale/v1/ link.
